verdict.rationale: Ironclad publishes a comprehensive public developer hub with Records, Workflows, and Records APIs, OAuth2 authentication, webhooks, and dedicated guides (launch workflows, embed clickwrap, data exports), confirmed live via probes (llms.txt, docs.md endpoints returning 200). This is a documented, general-purpose public API suitable for programmatic/agentic access, though no OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found and no independent hands-on developer report corroborates the API's real-world reliability. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable schema and independent third-party developer testimonials confirming API robustness.
